background_image_description: An abstract watercolor plume of blues—from deep navy to airy cyan—spreads diagonally across a white background, tapering to a point on the right. Soft, layered edges create a cloud-like gradient and a triangular composition.

nodes.svg_description: Thin elliptical outline behind the headline; no fill, 2px stroke in semi-transparent white (#ffffff, ~45% opacity). The ellipse is elongated horizontally, roughly 760x380px, visually tilted about 12 degrees clockwise and centered around the text block.

Three small, four-point sparkle stars rendered as diamond crosses with rounded points, solid fill #ffffff. One larger star (~34x34px) above-left of the text block; two smaller stars (~22x22px and ~16x16px) to the lower-right of the text block, spaced ~60px apart vertically.
